To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) Pellets are a new dosage form that can be used for oral drug delivery, and (2) pellets are a new dosage for oral drug delivery that can be used.
the use of a novel MUPS formulation of the drug in the form of pellets, which can be easily coated with a film coating, is a viable alternative to the use of the drug as a solution.

the use of a 2% solution of sodium carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) as a binder in pelletization process of theophylline, a water-insoluble drug, results in pellets that have a smooth surface, a narrow particle size distribution and a high content of theophyllin.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new oral dosage form that combines the advantages of the conventional dosage forms, i.e. tablets and capsules, while avoiding some of their limitations, and which can be manufactured using the same equipment as used for conventional dosage forms.
the development and characterization of pellets for oral dosage forms.
the design and development of multi unit pelletized systems (MUPS) containing active ingredients and/or excipients.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
pellets must be spherical, free flowing, smooth surfaced, and contain a high drug load, with a narrow particle size distribution.
pellets are small, free flowing units of uniform size and shape, with high bulk density, containing high percentage of the active ingredients.
pellets are free-flowing particles of uniform size, density and shape.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the pelletization of a poorly water-soluble drug, carbamazepine, was achieved by a novel technique, the multi unit particulates systems (MUPS), which was developed to overcome the limitations of the conventional pelletization methods.
the pellets are a novel and innovative dosage form for the oral route.
the pellets were produced successfully with the help of the fluid bed granulator and the properties were determined.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can make a very high quality, very low cost drug product that has a high dose of active pharmaceutical ingredient in it.
the MUPS approach is an attractive way to deliver a drug that is poorly soluble in the stomach, and the approach is particularly attractive if the drug is also unstable in the stomach.
we have shown the possibility to fabricate MUPS with high bioavailability.
